meta.name: woz-kb
meta.description: Knowledge-base tuning for the /woz-review reviewer. `woz-kb tune` is the start-to-finish command — distill human PR comments, backtest the reviewer against historical merged PRs, learn from what it missed, apply to the KB, and re-measure the recall/precision lift — for one repo or every repo in an org. `woz-kb backtest` exposes the individual building blocks (run, --tune, --missed-report, --org-tune, --ab-compare).
